GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up for clear running from the 500m until the 300m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 7.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Ground in Straight # ran on fairly

Jumped Ok , scrubbed along in second half Two Wide 8 Lengths 800m, came to Middle Of Track from the corner, battled on well at the one pace last 200m and was not far off placing # Even Effort

jumped awkwardly . Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Back 1 length midrace & chasing 3 Wide @ 500m. Pressured & chasing Five Wide (6L from lead) on home turn. Made slight ground in last 200m. # OK for further.
